# ARGUS V9 — Algorithmic Trading System by Simplai.tech

## What is ARGUS?

ARGUS is an autonomous algorithmic trading system for MetaTrader 5 (MT5), built by Simplai.tech. It runs 10 battle-tested trading strategies 24/5 with zero manual intervention. The name comes from Argus Panoptes — the all-seeing giant of Greek mythology.

## Key Facts

- **Creator**: Simplai.tech
- **Platform**: MetaTrader 5 (MT5)
- **Strategies**: 10 proprietary strategies (trend-following, mean reversion, scalping, multi-session)
- **AI Component**: ML signal validation model (AUC 0.773) trained on 17,965 real trades
- **Backtest Result**: +331% over 3 years (verified MT5 Strategy Tester)
- **Live Performance**: Profit Factor 1.28, net profit +$5,090 on verified live account
- **Risk Management**: Dynamic lot sizing, drawdown protection, configurable RR ratios
- **News Guard**: Automatic trading pause before high-impact economic events
- **Session Intelligence**: Asia / London / New York session classification with session-specific activation
- **Notifications**: Real-time Telegram alerts for every trade entry, exit, and system event
- **Backtest Suite**: Full historical testing with Monte Carlo simulation, Sharpe ratio, PDF reports

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need trading experience?**
No. ARGUS handles signal generation, validation, and execution automatically. A setup call is included with every plan.

**Which brokers are supported?**
Any MT5-compatible broker. ARGUS connects via the standard MT5 terminal.

**Is performance guaranteed?**
No. Past performance does not guarantee future results. All performance figures are real but historical.

**How quickly can I start?**
After payment, setup takes under 48 hours including the onboarding call.
